title: Pure Risebell
summary: The Risebell storyline archetype follows Risebell, his sister Saambell the Summoner, and Hypnosister across Risebell the Summoner (Level 3 Normal Pendulum), Risebell the Star Adjuster (Level 3 Effect), and Risebell the Star Psycher (Level 4 Effect)! Every Risebell card manipulates Monster Levels on the field: when Risebell the Star Adjuster is Special Summoned (via Emergency Teleport on either player's turn!), it increases any monster's Level by 1, 2, or 3, while Risebell the Summoner and Star Psycher increase Levels by 1! Pair Level 3 Risebell the Star Adjuster and Risebell the Summoner with Level 3 Psychic Tuners (Psychic Wheeleder and Psychic Tracker) to modulate Levels anywhere from 6 to 9—letting any 2 monsters Synchro Summon Level 6 Hyper Psychic Riser, Level 7 Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, Level 8 Crystal Wing / Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, or Level 9 Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen!

allow.Psychic Wheeleder: Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell, tunes with Level-modulated Risebell into any Level 6–9 Synchro, and destroys 1 opponent's monster on Synchro Summon!
allow.Psychic Tracker: Level 3 EARTH Psychic non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell and gives any Synchro Monster summoned using it +600 ATK!
allow.Emergency Teleport: Quick-Play Spell that Special Summons Level 3 Psychic Risebell the Star Adjuster or Psychic Wheeleder directly from hand or Deck—immediately triggering Star Adjuster's Level modulation!
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Level 3 WIND Psychic Normal Pendulum Monster Risebell the Summoner directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
allow.Painful Decision: Sends 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster (Risebell the Summoner) from your Deck to the GY to add another copy of Risebell the Summoner from your Deck to your hand.
allow.Virtual World Kyubi - Shenshen: Level 9 WIND Psychic Synchro boss (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +3 Levels to Level 6!): banishes any card sent from the field to the GY and revives itself from the GY!
allow.Clear Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 7 WIND Dragon Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +1 Level to Level 4!) that negates Level 5+ monster effects and targeting monster effects.
allow.Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 8 WIND Dragon Synchro that negates any monster effect once per turn.
allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Level 8 Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +2 Levels to Level 5!) that banishes an opponent's monster that activates its effect as a Quick Effect!
allow.Hyper Psychic Riser: Level 6 EARTH Psychic Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell with +0 Level change) that locks down attacks and monster effects.
allow.Totem Bird: Rank 3 WIND Xyz (2 Level 3 WIND monsters: Risebell the Star Adjuster + Risebell the Summoner!) that detaches 2 materials to negate and destroy any Spell or Trap Card!

main: Risebell the Star Adjuster

Core Level 3 WIND Psychic Effect Monster: when Special Summoned, targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by up to 3 until the end of this turn—tuning with Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder into any Level 6, 7, 8, or 9 Synchro Monster!
Risebell the Summoner

Core Scale 2 Level 3 WIND Psychic Normal Pendulum Monster: once per turn in the Pendulum Zone, targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by 1; serves as Level 3 target for Unexpected Dai and Wheeleder/Tracker.
Risebell the Star Psycher

Level 4 WIND Psychic Effect Monster (1500 ATK / 1500 DEF): once per turn during EITHER player's turn (Quick Effect), targets 1 face-up monster on the field and increases its Level by 1—disrupting opponent's Level math!
Saambell the Summoner
Risebell's sister (Level 2 WIND Spellcaster): while you control another monster with the same Level as this card, Special Summons 1 monster from your hand with that same Level!
Hypnosister
Level 4 WIND Psychic: gains +800 ATK/DEF while 1+ cards are in the Pendulum Zones, and destroys any Pendulum Summoned monster at the start of the Damage Step while 2+ cards are in the Pendulum Zones!
Psychic Wheeleder

Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell, tunes with Level-modulated Risebell into any Level 6–9 Synchro, and destroys 1 monster on Synchro Summon!
Psychic Tracker
Level 3 EARTH Psychic non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control Level 3 Risebell and gives your Synchro Monster +600 ATK.
Emergency Teleport
Core Quick-Play Spell: Special Summons Risebell the Star Adjuster directly from hand or Deck—immediately triggering Star Adjuster's on-Special-Summon effect to boost a monster's Level by 1 to 3!
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Level 3 Normal Monster Risebell the Summoner directly from your Deck while you control no monsters.
Painful Decision
Sends 1 Risebell the Summoner from your Deck to the GY to add another Risebell the Summoner from your Deck to your hand.
Wavering Eyes
Quick-Play Spell that destroys cards in the Pendulum Zones to burn for 500 and search any Pendulum Monster.
extra: Level 9 WIND Psychic Synchro boss (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +3 Levels to Level 6!): banishes cards sent from field to GY and revives itself from GY!
Level 8 Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +2 Levels to Level 5!) that banishes an opponent's monster when it activates its effect!
Level 7 WIND Dragon Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell boosted by +1 Level to Level 4, or Level 3 Wheeleder + Level 4 Risebell the Star Psycher!).
Level 8 WIND Dragon Synchro for monster effect negation.
Level 6 EARTH Psychic Synchro (Level 3 Psychic Wheeleder + Level 3 Risebell with +0 Level change) that locks down opposing attacks and effects.

Rank 7: detaches 1 material to target and take permanent control of 1 opponent's monster.
